guard.note: Almost Unified, then TAG_TO_ITEM_MAP; else (the only FMLPaths.CONFIGDIR read) open + parse config/cucumber-tags.json: a failed parse logs the error with its stack trace (the only slf4j Logger.error(String, Throwable)) and answers AIR, nothing remembered
clears TAG_TO_ITEM_MAP and rereads the file (TagsUpdatedEvent)

cucumber_tag_file_failure_memo.conversion: @Inject before getItemForTag's FMLPaths.CONFIGDIR read (cancellable): AIR at once while config/cucumber-tags.json has exactly the state (exists, file, last modified, length) it had before a read that failed; @WrapOperation of its error log call remembers that state; @Inject HEAD of reloadTagMappings forgets it. Fix: one error line per broken file state instead of one per unmapped tag and call; same answers. Runtime flag cucumberTagFileFailureMemo. Helper bons.furious.patch.cucumber_coo49.CucumberTagFiles.
cucumber_tag_file_failure_memo.license: Cucumber (MIT): no code carried; the hooks decide whether the file is read again

guard.note: tag tooltips + advanced tooltips: block / item / fluid tag lists; CTRL -> the lists, else HOLD_CTRL_FOR_TAGS when any list is not empty
Capabilities.FluidHandler.ITEM: per non-empty tank fluid its sorted tag list (called once by both paths)

cucumber_tag_tooltip_presence_first.conversion: @Inject HEAD (cancellable) of TagTooltipHandler.onItemTooltip: with tag tooltips and advanced tooltips on and CTRL not held, add HOLD_CTRL_FOR_TAGS iff the block (not air) has a tag, the item has a tag, or a fluid of FluidHelper.getFluidTags (called once, as the original) has a tag; otherwise the original. Runtime flag cucumberTagTooltipPresenceFirst. Helper bons.furious.patch.cucumber_coo49.CucumberTagTooltips.
